days.title: Lakes and High Peaks
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: lago di Garda
stops.detail: Its territory coincides with that of the Garda Lemon Riviera and extends from the shores of Lake Garda to the long mountain ridge that in the North coincides with the border between Lombardy and the autonomous province of Trento (Ledro Valley) and in the east with the Sabbia Valley, including nine municipalities for a total of about 27,000 inhabitants.

stops.name: lago di Valvestino
stops.detail: Inside, in the main valley, the park hosts Lake Valvestino, an artificial reservoir from the sixties, a venue for sport fishing.

stops.name: Monte Caplone
stops.detail: The highest point of the park is Mount Caplone which reaches 1,976 meters above sea level.

days.title: Nature Reserves and Historical Ridges
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: riserva naturale dell'ex lago di Bondo
stops.detail: The nature reserve of the former Lake Bondo is included in the park.

stops.name: fienili di Cima Rest
stops.detail: Characteristic are the barns of Cima Rest (1,200 m) in the municipality of Magasa, with very pointed thatched roofs (according to some of Lombard origin, according to others Austro-Hungarian), and the military road excavated along the border ridges during the First World War.

stops.name: Monte Tombea
stops.detail: Among all the Saxifraga tombeanensis, which takes its name from Mount Tombea, the second peak of the Park (1,950 m).
